text:
Ava Chen: Heads-up: landing in PDX late Thur. Any late-night spots near downtown that do soba/ramen + decent coffee next morning? Prefer small, local places.
Rafael: Koi Fusion is late but it's poke, not what you asked. For ramen check out Afuri-ish spot 'Noodle Nook' on SW 3rd 3 they close at 11:30.
Jo: Noodle Nook is tiny. plan for a line but they move fast. they have a good veg dashi option.
Noah: If you want coffee after, try Ruby Coffee Roasters (open early) or Cloud St. Espresso for single-origin pour overs. both walkable from downtown.
Ava Chen: sweet. how about something open later (midnight-ish) for a nightcap and small bites?
Rafael: For late-night izakaya vibes, "Moonlit Bento" does small plates until 1am on weekends. it's more fusion but cozy.
Jo: Also recommend checking hours on IG bc small spots shift seasonally.
KitchenBot: FYI: Local curfew/last-kitchen times often change. Run `kitchen-hours pdx Noodle Nook` to verify tonight's closing time.
Ava Chen: thanks! Any advice for walking back to hotels from Moonlit Bento? I'm staying near the waterfront.
Noah: Waterfront is safe but bring a jacket 1 3 it gets windy. rideshares are cheap late if you want no-walk option.
Rafael: Pro-tip: Ruby Coffee's take-home croissants sell out quickly; go early.
Jo: If you want a late boba/sweet fix, 'Lantern Tea' does warm matcha floats until midnight.
Ava Chen: booked. will try Noodle Nook Fri night, Moonlit Bento for late snack. Thanks y'all :heart: 
KitchenBot: Saved to traveler notes: "PDX late-night eats: Noodle Nook (ramen, veg dashi), Moonlit Bento (izakaya), Ruby Coffee (morning), Lantern Tea (late sweets)"
Noah: bring pics. :camera_with_flash: 
Ava Chen: will do!
